Blend fill into a derived colour mapping

Source: R/scale-blend-DEV.R
aes_blendcolour.Rd

Note: this sets colour, not fill — fill is the value it reads from, colour is what it derives. Maps colour to a blended version of fill, evaluated after scale training via ggplot2::after_scale(). Attaches no scale itself — use scale_fill_blendcolour_discrete() (or _continuous/_binned) for a ready-to-plot version that also scales fill.

Usage

aes_blendcolour(blend = NULL)

Arguments

blend

A function that takes a colour vector and returns a blended colour vector.

Value

A ggplot2 mapping object (as returned by ggplot2::aes()).
